solve_game_value_iteration: solve a 1-player or 2-player zero-sum game using value iteration with a given depth limit and convergence threshold
run_value_iteration_cyclic: run value iteration on a cyclic game by setting the cyclic_game flag to true for games with state loops
test_simultaneous_node_solving: test value iteration on games with simultaneous moves by assembling and solving matrix subgames
build_value_function: build the optimal value function for a perfect information game by iterating until error falls below threshold
handle_chance_nodes: handle chance nodes in game trees by performing lookahead to compute transition probabilities to future states
